issues.title: Missing Logic-Specific Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: The provided AC files (97-acceptance-criteria.md) only cover 'meta' tree-health (file existence, naming, banners) but lack GWT criteria for the actual pipeline logic (SHA-dedup, version resolution, checksumming).
issues.fix: Add GWT scenarios to 97-acceptance-criteria.md for SHA-cache hits, version parsing from tags vs branches, and artifact retention enforcement.

issues.title: Dangling References to Missing Files
issues.why: The Feature Inventory and Cross-Refs cite files like '03-vulnerability-scanning.md' and '04-install-script-generation.md' which are listed as 'Active' but their content is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Provide the content for all files listed in the Feature Inventory or mark them as 'External/Future'.

issues.title: Race Condition in SHA Cache Write
issues.why: While the spec notes the risk of separate jobs, it doesn't explicitly define behavior if the 'Save SHA' step fails due to network issues while the build itself succeeded.
issues.fix: Add a requirement that cache-save failures should emit a warning but not fail the build, ensuring the current run still completes.
